outline:
深入了解各種數位調變技術.
1. Bandpass signals and systems
2. Sampling theory
3. Power spectral density
4. Random processes
5. Baseband pulse transmission (PAM)
6. Passband digital transmission (PSK, QAM, FSK, CPFSK, CPM, MSK, GMSK, OFDM)
schedule:
1-2週   Bandpass signals and systems
3-4週   Sampling theory
5週     Power spectral density
6-8週   Random processes
9週     Baseband pulse transmission (PAM)
10-17週 Passband digital transmission (PSK, QAM, FSK, CPFSK, CPM, MSK, GMSK, OFDM)
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】
